notes.title: V2.42 Update: Double the Fun with Co-op Mode!
notes.content:
Hey Gamers!

I've been focusing on enhancing the Player 2 experience lately. This time, I've made a bunch of updates and optimizations to the Co-op mode, giving you more control and making co-op play even more fun. If you love playing with friends, you should definitely check out the new and improved 2P mode. Here's what's new in this update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129965/c81647913c0c437f4559de85a764a73cf57b45e0.png[/img]

[h2]New Features in Co-op Mode[/h2]
[list]
[*] Player 2 can now pick up and use bullets.
[*] Player 2 can interact with buildings, including repairing, crafting, and standing on.
[*] Player 2 can pick up most items like new buildings, puzzles, and armor (except those requiring mouse aiming).
[*] In co-op campaign challenges, the number of enemies and the boss's health will increase.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes and Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the campaign disconnection ranking bug.
[*] Fixed the missing plane bug in unmanned mode.
[*] Fixed occasional bug with swarm extermination.
[*] Fixed the blue spiders collision box bug. 
[*] Adjusted the pause duration for the boss "Lucifer".
[*] Reduced the production capacity of the gold center.
[*] Temporary shop layout adjustments
[/list]
Thanks for all your support! As a solo developer, I appreciate your understanding of any imperfections.

Join our community to chat with me directly and share your thoughts and suggestions!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: V2.26
notes.content:
1. By obtaining the scanning ability in advance, we can unlock it after completing Chapter 2. (This is more advantageous for new players)
2. The collection station with double efficiency will be obtained after the end of 4-E. If you haven't owned it yet, please call 4-E again.
3. The excavation speed of magnets and mineral veins has doubled.
4. Fixed a small bug in a pop-up window.
5. The basic attack power of strategic cruise ships has become 6. (It's just a mascot)
6. The late stage of the endless mode has increased some difficulty (99% of players are not affected)
7. Some details including synchronized version number
